title: Can’t wait to see #Hadestown’s new cast on September 1st!
transcript: Hadestown just announced that Ben Davis is going to be the next Hades and I am so excited about this. Ben has been in so many musicals, Broadway, regionally, a lot of operas as well. Right now you can see him as father in ragtime at Lincoln Center Theater I feel like the father to Hades pipeline is like, pretty great. Obviously the original Hades casting was not good and not well vetted. Yes, I've seen statement and I hope he does listen and learn. but I'm so thankful to everyone who spoke up both online and in person. I know there are multiple members of the cast who, like, went to the team directly and advocated, which is a huge thing to ask an actor to do. So I'm just really thankful to everyone and I think this will be much better for all of us. Last year there was a dream roles concert and Ben, who was in Heathers at the time sang hey little songbird. So I'm glad that we have this cause he sounds great. Hey little songbird, Cat got your tongue. Always a pity, for one so pretty and young, when poverty comes to clip your wings and knock the wind right out of your lungs hey nobody sings on empty
classificationReason: Reacting to the casting news of Ben Davis as the next Hades; creator has not yet seen the new cast (title says 'Can't wait to see'). Pure casting news commentary.
